artworks.title: St. Joseph; St. Joachim;  St. Benedict, Abbot; St. Catharine of Sweden
artworks.description: The image contains four oval illustrations set against a plain background. In the top left illustration, an older man with a beard, wearing a halo and a long robe, is shown full-length, holding a staff in his right hand and leading a young boy with short hair, also with a halo, in his left hand. The landscape background features a small settlement to the left. The top right illustration depicts a bearded man in a long garment leading a child, each with haloes, next to a veiled woman, all shown in full-length, standing against a simple landscape. In the bottom left illustration, an older man with a halo, in a long robe and cloak, kneels with folded hands before a desk with open books and a crozier, and there's a raven on the window sill behind him. In the bottom right illustration, a veiled woman with a halo, clad in a long robe, leans down to tend to a seated individual with a hat, with a simple landscape featuring distant buildings in the background and a tree arching above. Each scene is labeled with text and a month of March date at the bottom.

artworks.title: St. Fidelis; St. Agapetus; St. Dula; St. Latro Dimas
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four religious scenes. The drawing is composed of four separate oval illustrations, each depicting different religious figures and scenes. The first illustration shows a figure being attacked by two others with clubs. The second illustration shows a serene figure standing in a rocky landscape with another figure in the distance. The third illustration depicts an act of violence with one figure attacking another who is kneeling. The fourth illustration shows three figures on crosses, suggesting a scene of crucifixion, with a landscape in the background. The style of the drawing is highly detailed, utilizing fine lines to create texture and depth, typical of the style seen in religious iconography.

artworks.title: The Annunciation; St. Castulus; St. Rupert; St. Gontran
artworks.description: The image is divided into four panels. In the top left panel, a figure is receiving a divine message from an angel. In the upper right panel, a man holding a palm branch is depicted. The bottom left panel shows a robed figure wearing a bishop's mitre interacting with kneeling individuals. The bottom right panel shows a bearded man with a crown interacting with two individuals. Each scene has a caption with the name of the figure depicted and the date in March.

artworks.title: Sts. Jonas & Barachisius; St. John Climacus, Abbot; St. Benjamin; Sts. Quirinus & Bal
artworks.description: Four oval illustrations arranged in a grid. The top left illustration shows figures engaged in an action, with one person operating a saw, while another figure stands in the background. The top right illustration features a seated figure in long robes holding a book under a large rock. The bottom left image depicts a robed figure tied to a post with another person behind them. The bottom right scene shows a standing person gesturing towards a smaller figure. The backgrounds are minimalistic with sparse landscapes.

artworks.title: St. Hugo; St. Francis of Paula; St. Mary of Egypt; St. Richard
artworks.description: The image contains four separate illustrations, each within an oval frame. In the top left frame, labeled "S. Hugo Episc." and "1 April," a man is shown reclining against a structure. He has a halo, suggesting sanctity, and is dressed in robes. His head is turned slightly to the right with a thoughtful expression, and stars are depicted in the sky above him. In the background, a group of figures stands on a hill. The top right frame, titled "S. Francis De Paula" and "2 April," depicts a man sitting facing the water. He has a long beard and wears a halo as a sign of sanctity, dressed in flowing robes. He holds a book. The sky shows clouds and rays of light, and in the distance, individuals are shown in a small boat. The bottom left frame, marked "S. Ricard" and "3 April," features a man plowing a field with oxen seen from the side. His body is bent as he works, and he also bears a halo. The background depicts a landscape with rolling hills and small figures off to the left. In the bottom right frame, labeled "S. Maria Egipti" and "2 April," a woman is shown standing with hands together in front of her chest. She is covered with long, flowing hair and also has a halo. The setting includes trees and terrain with small figures in the backdrop, and the sky is adorned with clouds and some light rays. All the frames are depicted in a simple, single-color engraved style with a plain background.

artworks.title: St. Ambrose; St. Vincent Ferrer; St. Celestin; St. Lazarus
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four religious scenes. The top left image shows a figure with a tall hat speaking to another figure kneeling before them. The top right image shows a kneeling figure looking up and gesturing towards a serpent on an altar. The bottom left image depicts a seated figure surrounded by other figures, suggesting a council or gathering. The bottom right scene shows a standing figure with a halo addressing another figure in a dramatic setting. The illustrations are detailed with fine lines and shading, resembling classic pen and ink techniques.

artworks.title: St. Perpetuus; St. Mary of Cleophas; St. Ezechiel; St. Leo the Great
artworks.description: Four engravings depict religious figures in oval frames, numbered for specific dates in April. In the first engraving (April 8), a person wearing a cloak with a halo gestures towards people on a rooftop in front of a building with scaffolding and ladders. The text reads "S. PERPETVUUS EPVS." In the second engraving (April 9), a person cloaked with a halo stands with arms open in front of crosses and a building. The text reads "S. MARIA CLEOPHÆ." In the third engraving (April 10), a group scene shows figures, including one with a halo, surrounded by guards in armor. The text reads "S. EZECHIEL PROPH." In the fourth engraving (April 11), a person with a halo addresses a crowd of soldiers with a cross and clouds above, with other figures looking on. The text reads "S. LEO MAGNVS PAPA." Each engraving features the name "Israel exc." below the illustration, and the background in each scene includes architectural elements or natural settings to provide context.

artworks.title: St. Victor; St. Justinus; Sts. Tiburtius and Valerianus; Sts. Basilissa and Anastasia
artworks.description: The image features four oval engravings within separate panels. The first panel is labeled "S. VICTOR MART." and dated 'April 12'. A man with a halo stands facing forward with one arm raised slightly, opposite another man by a column. The second panel is labeled "S. IVSTINVS PHILOSOP. MART." and dated 'April 13'. A man with a halo is shown in profile standing in a doorway offering a scroll to another man, while another figure kneels in the background. The third panel is labeled "SS. TIBVRTIVS ET VALERIA NVS" and dated 'April 14', showing a man kneeling beside another standing figure, with an angel-like figure holding a wreath from above, framed by clouds and architectural elements. The final panel, labeled "SS. BASILISSA ET ANASTAS." and dated ‘April 13’, depicts figures in a setting resembling stone ruins or a graveyard, with sunlight rays descending. The engravings depict religious or historical scenes with figures wearing halos, set against detailed landscapes and architecture without modern elements. Each panel is framed with simple lines, highlighting the oval centers of the scenes.

artworks.title: St. Maria Doloru; St. Stephen, Abbot; St. Apoloni; St. Timon
artworks.description:
This drawing features four religious scenes in oval frames corresponding to specific dates in April:

1. "16 APRIL" shows a crucifixion scene.
2. "17 APRIL" depicts a religious figure distributing garments or blessings to kneeling figures.
3. "18 APRIL" shows a figure attacking another figure with a sword in a chaotic environment.
4. "19 APRIL" presents a saintly figure gesturing towards a marauding figure near a crucifixion scene. 

The drawing portrays religious themes and narratives with intricate detail and dynamic compositions.

artworks.title: St. Theodorus; St. Agnes of Monte Pulciano; St. Anselme, Archbishop of Canterbury; St. Opportuna and Virgin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four religious scenes associated with saints and events in the month of April. The first panel depicts St. Theodore encountering demonic creatures. In the second panel, figures are gathered around a tomb. The third panel features St. Anselm and a seated monk. The last panel shows St. Opportuna comforting a person in bed. Each panel is detailed with line work, capturing the gestures and significance attributed to these figures.

artworks.title: St. George; St. Sabas; St. Mark, Evangelist; St. Marcellin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple religious scenes each appearing in their own oval frame. The drawing consists of four sections, each depicting a different event. In the top left, a figure rides a horse and appears victorious over a creature below, with a spear raised aloft. The top right shows a person submerged in what looks like boiling water while others around seem engaged in an action. The bottom left shows a person writing at a desk with a lion nearby, set within what appears to be an architectural interior. The bottom right displays a figure in papal attire kneeling, with a scene of commotion in the background. Each scene is meticulously detailed with line work, encapsulated within an oval.

artworks.title: St. Anastasius; St. Theodora; Sts. Vitalis and Valeria; St. Peter Martyr
artworks.description:
This is a drawing with four oval shapes, each representing a specific date in April.

The top left scene shows a robed figure with a tall hat making a gesture to a kneeling person, surrounded by standing observers. It is labeled for April 27.

The top right scene displays two figures kneeling and praying with another figure standing over them, holding a sword or staff, with a cityscape in the background. It is labeled for April 28.

The bottom left scene depicts two figures with halos, a male and a female, walking hand in hand in a serene setting. It is also labeled for April 28.

The bottom right scene shows a man wielding a sword over another figure in a defensive pose. It is labeled for April 29.

artworks.title: St. Catharine of Siena; St. Marian; St. Eutropius; St. Sophia
artworks.description: The image features four oval panels with detailed illustrations. The top left panel shows a man and a woman interacting, both with halos and surrounded by architectural elements. The top right panel shows a man hanging upside-down in a city setting. The bottom left panel depicts a woman kneeling with a figure holding a sword behind her. In the bottom right panel, a woman stands wearing robes, holding a feather and a circular object with a halo. The background includes architectural elements and distant landscapes. The image format resembles a calendar, with "29 April" and "30 April" noted under the panels.

artworks.title: St. Philip and James the Less, Apostles; St. Anthanasius; The Invention of the Cross; St. Pelagia
artworks.description:
The image features four circular vignette illustrations.

In the first vignette, there are two full-bodied figures standing. The person on the left holds a long staff with a cross, and the person on the right has long hair, a halo, a similar robe, and a tall staff. They stand in front of a cross on a hill.

The second vignette shows a figure mounted on a donkey or horse, wearing a bishop's mitre and a robe with a halo, approaching a city gate with a group of people.

The third vignette depicts a standing figure holding a long cross staff with long hair, wearing a robe belted at the waist, against a cityscape background.

In the fourth vignette, a woman stands behind a large ox with long hair, gesturing near her chest, with small buildings on a hillside in the background.

Each vignette is labeled, potentially related to a calendar or religious theme. The focus is on the figures and their surroundings, with minimal background details.

artworks.title: The Conversion of Saint  Augustine; Saint Hilary; Saint John before the Latin Portal; Saint John of Damascus
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing four religious themed scenes within oval frames. The top left scene depicts an individual kneeling under a tree with two figures and rays of light in the background. The top right scene shows a figure in a cape standing next to another figure kneeling before an altar with a candle, inside a space with columns and an arched entry. The bottom left scene illustrates two individuals; one standing waist-deep in a container of liquid with hands raised in prayer, while the other stands outside the container holding a staff. The bottom right scene features an interior space with a seated person and another emerging from clouds above.

artworks.title: St. Stanislaus; The Apparition of St. Michael; The Translation of St. Nicholas; St. Gregory of Nazianzus
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four religious scenes, each contained within an oval and accompanied by textual labels. Each individual image depicts distinct events or figures from religious narratives. The upper left scene shows a kneeling figure interacting with an armored figure inside an architectural setting. The upper right illustration features a heavenly figure in flight above a rocky landscape. In the lower left, a maritime scene unfolds with a small boat carrying several figures. The lower right scene depicts a seated figure writing. Detailed linework across the compositions gives each a classic and intricate appearance, with a focus on storytelling through visual cues and written elements.

artworks.title: St. Job, Prophet; St. Gangulphus; St. Epiphanius; St. Mary of Martyrs
artworks.description:
This drawing features four circular illustrations of religious scenes associated with the month of May.

The top left scene depicts a seated figure, likely the prophet Job, receiving visitors under swirling skies and architectural structures.

The top right shows a figure with a halo holding a sword while another kneels before a well or spring.

The bottom left illustrates a bishop gesturing towards a figure kneeling, with a demonic creature fleeing.

The bottom right scene portrays a crowned figure surrounded by a crowd. Each scene is separated by decorative oval borders, implying a narrative through time reflected in date annotations.

artworks.title: St. Servatius; St. Boniface; St. Pachomius; St. Corona
artworks.description: This drawing features four religious scenes enclosed in separate ovals. The top left scene shows a person in a tomb-like structure with rain falling. The top right scene depicts two figures near an architectural structure. The bottom left scene shows a figure standing with another figure in a cloud above offering a gesture. The bottom right scene shows a person tied to two trees. Each oval is detailed with shading and line work typical of iconographic illustrations.

artworks.title: St. Dympna; St. Peregrinus; St. Restituta; St. Dioscorus
artworks.description:
This is a drawing with four oval illustrations set within a grid. Each illustration depicts a different scene with historical or religious significance.

The top left oval shows a figure holding a sword over a kneeling character with architecture in the background. The top right oval shows a figure in a large hat and robe standing on a platform addressing a crowd with rocky formations in the background.

The bottom left oval shows a sailing ship in motion across the water. The bottom right oval depicts three figures, one tied to a stake with two others gesturing around them. 

Each image is labeled with text around the perimeter of the oval and a date, likely representing specific saints’ days or important events in religious history.

artworks.title: St. Potentiana; St. Dunstan; St. Yvo; St. Bernardinus of Siena
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four oval-shaped scenes. The top left scene shows figures tending to a recumbent individual against a background landscape. The top right scene features a central figure in ecclesiastical robes with a staff, accompanied by others. The bottom left scene shows an exchange between two individuals in a town or city setting. The bottom right scene illustrates a kneeling individual offering a gesture, possibly directed towards another figure near an architectural feature.

artworks.title: Sts. Nicostratus and Anthiocus; St. Julia; St. Desiderius; Sts. Susanna, Palladia, and Martiana
artworks.description: The image consists of four illustrated panels depicting religious figures in various poses. In the top left panel, two figures are shown standing side by side, holding large objects. In the top right panel, three figures are near water, with one reclining on the ground. The bottom left panel shows a kneeling figure surrounded by others holding swords and shields. The bottom right panel depicts three standing figures holding large objects, with two smaller figures at their sides. The background for each panel is minimalistic, focusing on the figures.

artworks.title: St. Urban; The Translation of St. Mary of James; St. Quadrat; St. Julius
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four religious scenes illustrated within oval frames. Each panel is labeled with a saint's name and a date in May. The top-left scene depicts a central figure with a halo being struck by two men with clubs. The top-right scene shows a figure with a halo being escorted amidst a crowd. The bottom-left panel illustrates a lone figure with a halo, appearing to be in prayer or deep thought. The bottom-right scene shows a figure with a halo being escorted by three other figures, two of whom are soldiers bearing swords. The drawings focus on religious iconography typical of classical illustrations.

artworks.title: St. Germanus of Paris; St. Maximinus; St. Emmelia; St. Petronilla
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four scenes arranged in a grid, each with a label of a date in May and featuring distinct religious imagery. The upper left scene, dated the 28th, shows a person lying on a bed with another standing beside them; a cloth is draped over the foot of the bed. The upper right scene, dated the 29th, illustrates two individuals in a gesture of meeting or prayer surrounded by a pastoral setting. In the lower left, dated the 30th, a figure is shown in a forested area in a posture suggesting supplication or prayer. The lower right scene, dated the 31st, shows individuals with religious attire, one seated in a waiting posture, possibly in conversation or receiving instruction from a standing figure, in front of a structure resembling a church.

artworks.title: Sts. Pamphilius and Porphyrius; St. Blandina and Companions; St. Erasmus; St. Optatus
artworks.description: The image shows four oval vignettes of saints and scenes. The first vignette features two haloed figures in a outdoor setting. The second vignette shows a female figure with a halo standing next to a lion and another figure tied to a wheel in the background. The third vignette depicts a haloed figure with outspread arms surrounded by rays and leaves. The last vignette shows a kneeling, haloed figure wearing a bishop's mitre reading from a book and holding a staff. Each vignette is titled with a day in June and is drawn in monochrome with intricate detail.
